description: RETRACTED (2026-05-29): the per-λ Δ_λ formula does NOT close the deuteron. B(D) = m_e·|sum_with_interface| = 0.380 MeV undershoots AME (2.225) by -82.9%. The earlier 'no fitting / no separate C_knot parameter exists' claim is false: χ^λ here is already interface-inclusive (include_inter=True) and still misses by -83%; AME is only reached via C_knot = B_AME/(m_e·|sum|) = 5.852, a FITTED deficit ratio. Formula: B(D) = m_e × |Σ_λ y_λ · χ^λ(β_D) · sgn(w_0^{S_{λ'}}) · f^λ|. See docs/audits/2026-05-18-delta-lambda-gating-context.md (CORRECTION 2026-05-29).

data.conclusion: RETRACTED. NOT zero free parameters — AME closure requires the fitted C_knot = 5.852 deficit ratio. The Δ_λ gate remains open for the deuteron. The genuine zero-parameter deuteron closure is the scalar endomorphism B = m_e·Vol(𝓑₃)·Δtr = +0.19%, not this per-λ formula.
